skills.name: Sealed Bombs Square Formation
changes: This skill will now be replaced by 'Concealed Attack' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Concealed Attack
changes: Using ambush tactics to both attack and defend, Iruka deals 20 damage to one enemy and applies 'Shield Ally' to a random ally.
Energy:
Cooldown: None
Classes: Physical, Instant, Melee.

cards.note: This change gives Iruka a more versatile approach by allowing him to switch from an offensive formation to an ambush tactic. By replacing 'Sealed Bombs Square Formation' with 'Concealed Attack' for one turn, Iruka can deal damage to an enemy while simultaneously protecting a random ally. This improves his ability to contribute offensively without sacrificing his supportive role.

skills.name: Flying Thunder God
changes: This skill no longer extends the duration of 'Space-Time Kunai Scatter'.

cards.note: This nerf limits Minato's ability to maintain pressure on marked enemies by preventing 'Flying Thunder God' from extending the duration of 'Space-Time Kunai Scatter'. Minato will now need to manage his marks more carefully, reducing his ability to repeatedly take advantage of all targets and creating more opportunities for opponents to escape his combos.

skills.name: Fan Increase Moon
changes: This skill will now be replaced by 'Fan Interception' permanently after 3 uses.

skills.name: Fan Interception
changes: Temari uses her fan to defend an ally, granting that ally 15 points of damage reduction and making them unable to be killed for 1 turn.
Energy:
Cooldown: 2
Classes: Physical, Instant.

cards.note: This boost gives Temari a stronger defensive role as the battle progresses. After using 'Fan Increase Moon' three times, she gains permanent access to 'Fan Interception', allowing her to protect an ally with damage reduction and immunity to being killed. This rewards sustained use of her abilities while giving her team a valuable defensive option in longer battles.

skills.name: Chakra Rod
changes: This skill now costs 1 random chakra, instead of 1 taijutsu chakra.
This skill now removes chakra, instead of stealing.

skills.name: Violent Water Wave
changes: This skill now increases the cost of harmful non-mental skills, instead of chakra and ranged skills.
This skill now grants 15 points of damage reduction, instead of 50% damage reduction.

skills.name: Universal Pull
changes: This skill now counters harmful skills, instead of harmful physical or chakra skills.

cards.note: These changes improve Deva's flexibility and overall utility. 'Chakra Rod' becomes easier to use with a random chakra cost, while 'Violent Water Wave' can now disrupt a wider variety of skills and provides more consistent damage reduction. Additionally, 'Universal Pull' can counter all harmful skills, making Deva more reliable against different team compositions and allowing him to respond to a broader range of threats.

skills.name: Enton Amaterasu
changes: This skill's duration is now 3 turns, down 1 from 4.

cards.note: Reducing 'Enton Amaterasu''s duration from 4 to 3 turns limits Sasuke's ability to maintain prolonged pressure on his opponents. This change creates a shorter window for him to capitalize on the skill's effects, giving enemies more opportunities to recover.

skills.name: Three Headed Wolf
changes: This skill now ends when Kiba dies.

cards.note: Making 'Three Headed Wolf' end when Kiba dies prevents the skill from continuing to influence the battle after his defeat. This makes eliminating Kiba a more effective counterplay option and reduces the lasting impact of his transformation.

skills.name: Silent Mist
changes: This skill now triggers to the use of a new harmful skill, instead of the use of a new skill.

cards.note: This adjustment makes 'Silent Mist' more restrictive by requiring enemies to use a new harmful skill instead of any new skill to trigger its effects. Opponents can now use defensive or supportive abilities without activating the mist, providing more opportunities to play around Mei's control.

skills.name: Searing Combat
changes: This skill now has a cooldown of 1 turn, up 1 from 0.

cards.note: Adding a 1-turn cooldown to 'Searing Combat' limits Pakura's ability to use the skill repeatedly, reducing her offensive consistency and forcing her to manage its timing more carefully. This creates more opportunities for opponents to respond between uses.

skills.name: Cursed Seal Life-Giving
changes: This skill now reduces active cooldowns in 1 turn, down 1 from 2.

cards.note: Reducing 'Cursed Seal Life-Giving''s cooldown reduction from 2 turns to 1 weakens Kabuto's ability to accelerate his team's skill rotations. This change prevents allies from recovering powerful abilities too quickly, reducing the effectiveness of cooldown-dependent strategies while preserving his supportive utility.

skills.name: Ash Pile Diversion
changes: The blinding effect now works differently, randomizing harmful effects between enemies only.

cards.note: Changing the blinding effect to randomize between the enemy team will make Konohamaru's disruption less oppressive, allowing opponents to use defensive and supportive abilities more reliably, while making sure their harmful skills will affect enemies only.

skills.name: Airborne Palm Crush
changes: This skill now deals 30 damage, down 5 from 35.

skills.name: Gentle Fist Art: One Blow Body
changes: This skill no longer grants Neji 1 random chakra.
This skill now makes Neji's skills cost 1 less random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: The Price of Perseverance
changes: This skill now replaces 'Eight Trigrams: Vanishing Step' only, instead of all of Neji's skills.
This skill now also makes 'Heavenly Palm Rotation' and 'Airborne Palm Crush' lose their non-damage effects for the rest of the game.

cards.note: These adjustments will shift Neji's playstyle toward more strategic chakra management and skill timing. Replacing his chakra generation with temporary cost reduction will encourage better planning, while the passive's new drawbacks will make its activation less impactful. The reduced damage on Airborne Palm Crush will also help balance his offensive potential.

skills.name: Jiongu: Deadly Embrace
changes: This skill now deals 25 damage, up 10 from 15.
This skill now costs 2 random chakra, up 1 random.

skills.name: Heart Manifestation Assault
changes: This skill now requires the sacrifice of one Jiongu Heart to be used.

skills.name: Heart Extraction
changes: This skill now steals damage reduction effects only, instead of damage reduction skills.

cards.note: Requiring Kakuzu to sacrifice a Jiongu Heart will make Heart Manifestation Assault a more costly offensive option, forcing players to consider its long-term consequences. Limiting Heart Extraction to stealing damage reduction effects rather than entire skills will also reduce his versatility against defensive opponents.

skills.name: Paper Origami
changes: This skill's is now 3 turns, up 1 from 2.
This skill now has a cooldown of 3 turns, up 1 from 2.
This skill now makes Konan ignore stuns for 3 turns instead harmful effects.

skills.name: Crescent Moon Reverse Beheading
changes: This skill now costs 1 random chakra, instead of 1 taijutsu chakra.
This skill now deals 10 piercing damage, down 10 from 20.
This skill now has a cooldown of 2 turns, up 1 from 1.

cards.note: Changing the chakra cost to random will make this skill easier to fit into different team compositions. While the reduced piercing damage and increased cooldown limit its offensive potential, the improved chakra flexibility will make Omoi less dependent on specific chakra types.

skills.name: Three Headed Wolf
changes: This skill now removes physical and mental skills, instead of physical and chakra skills.
This skill now costs 1 bloodline and 1 random chakra, instead of 1 bloodline and 1 taijutsu chakra.
This skill now increases physical damage, instead of physical melee damage only.

skills.name: Tail Rotating Fang
changes: This skill now makes Kiba invulnerable to all harmful skills, instead of to physical skills only.
This skill now reduces non-affliction damage, instead of physical damage.

cards.note: These adjustments will make Kiba more versatile in both offensive and defensive situations. Expanding his damage boost to all physical skills and his invulnerability to all harmful skills will improve his consistency, while the broader damage reduction and more flexible chakra cost will allow him to perform better against a wider variety of opponents.

skills.name: Insect Assault
changes: This skill now has a cooldown of 1 turn, down 1 from 2.
This skill can no longer be used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Insect Coffin
changes: This skill now has a cooldown of 1 turn, down 2 from 3.
This skill can no longer be used on an enemy already affected by it.

cards.note: Reducing the cooldowns of both skills will allow Shino to apply pressure more frequently and maintain better control over the battlefield. Preventing these skills from being reapplied to already affected enemies will encourage more strategic target selection and limit repeated effects on the same opponent.

skills.name: Demonic Melody
changes: This skill now costs 1 genjutsu chakra, instead of 1 genjutsu and 1 random chakra.

cards.note: Reducing Demonic Melody's chakra cost will make Tayuya more efficient and easier to integrate into different team compositions, allowing her to apply pressure with fewer resources and execute her strategies more consistently.

skills.name: Wood Release: Wood Dragon
changes: This skill can now be used while active for 1 random chakra to steal all helpful skills from one enemy.
This skill now has a cooldown of 0 turns, down 2 from 2.

skills.name: Wood Release: Wood Human

This skill now has a cooldown of 0 turns, down 2 from 2.

skills.name: Wood Release: True Thousand Hands
changes: This skill now grants 35 points of destructible defense, up 5 from 30.

cards.note: These changes will make Hashirama more versatile and threatening in longer fights, allowing him to use his skills more frequently without cooldown restrictions. The increased destructible defense also improves his survivability, making him more reliable in both offensive and defensive situations.

skills.name: Granite Fist

cards.note: These changes will improve Kitsuchi's ability to disrupt enemy strategies by preventing opponents from benefiting from non-damage effects while also making his skill combinations more chakra-efficient. This will give him greater control over the battlefield and more opportunities to pressure enemies without relying on expensive setups.

skills.name: Reaping Scythe
changes: This skill now deals 20 damage, up 5 from 15.
This skill now has a cooldown of 1, up 1 from 0.
This skill now makes Hidan ignore stun effects for 1 turn.

cards.note: Hidan's 'Reaping Scythe' will now deal more damage while also providing protection against stuns, allowing him to maintain pressure against enemies who rely on disabling effects. The added cooldown balances these improvements by limiting how frequently he can use the skill.

skills.name: Raiton Gian
changes: This skill now deals 35 regular damage, instead of 30 piercing damage.
This skill now also makes the enemy's skills cost 1 additional random chakra for 1 turn.

cards.note: Kakuzu's 'Raiton Gian' will now focus more on disrupting enemy strategies rather than dealing piercing damage. The additional chakra cost will make it harder for opponents to execute their combos, while the increased regular damage keeps the skill threatening against unprotected enemies.

skills.name: Amaterasu Field

skills.name: Crow Genjutsu

skills.name: Mastered Mangekyou Sharingan

skills.name: Mangekyou Overexertion
changes: By pushing his Mangekyou Sharingan beyond its natural limits, Itachi deals 20 damage to one enemy. If this skill is available through: 'Amaterasu Field', the enemy will take 5 additional damage from 'Amaterasu Field' permanently; 'Crow Genjutsu', Itachi is healed for 15 health; 'Mastered Mangekyou Sharingan', Itachi removes all harmful skills from himself.
Energy:
Cooldown: None
Classes: Mental, Instant, Ranged.

cards.note: Itachi will now be able to deal damage without requiring the enemy to fall for any of his skills, gaining access to a different effect depending on which skill he uses. This allows him to adapt to different situations by dealing additional damage, recovering health, or removing harmful effects, making his kit more versatile and rewarding strategic decision-making.

skills.name: Parasite Clone Trap

The specific chakra of the copied skill will now be random chakra.

cards.note: This adjustment will make Parasitic Clone Trap more reliable by ensuring it copies a harmful skill rather than potentially wasting its effect on a defensive or supportive ability. Randomizing the copied skill's specific chakra cost will also make it easier to use in different situations, improving the skill's overall consistency and versatility.

skills.name: Summoning: Mayhem
changes: This skill now makes the countered enemy receive 15 additional damage from Shinobi Alliance Naruto (S)'s skills, instead of only from 'Mini Rasenshuriken'.

cards.note: This buff will make 'Summoning: Mayhem' more threatening by extending its additional damage effect to all of Shinobi Alliance Naruto (S)'s skills, rather than just 'Mini Rasenshuriken'. This will give Naruto more flexibility in punishing countered enemies and creating stronger offensive combinations.

skills.name: Empowered Devasting Punch

While empowered, this skill now deals 15 damage to the other enemies, up 5 from 10.

cards.note: Increasing the damage dealt to other enemies will improve Sakura's ability to pressure multiple opponents at once, making her more threatening in both regular and empowered states.

skills.name: Water Dragon Bomb

cards.note: Limiting the additional chakra cost to harmful skills will give opponents more freedom to use defensive and supportive abilities, reducing Mei's overall disruption potential while maintaining her ability to interfere with offensive strategies.

Opponents will now have more opportunities to respond with mental abilities while facing less damage and chakra disruption.

cards.note: Even though Shukaku Gaara currently has a 51% winrate, if we remove every match where Kushina was present, his winrate drops to just 37% across 121 matches. Since Kushina is already being nerfed in this patch, we also expect this combo to become weaker.

skills.name: Final Lotus
changes: This skill no longer deals 15 additional damage for each time Lee is damaged by 'Fifth Gate Opening'.
This skill now deals 80 damage, up 20 from 60.

cards.note:
One of the most common things we see from more casual players is that they interpret "Fifth Gate Opening" as a preparation skill, or as something that should be activated right from the start of the game. 
The idea behind these changes is to make it more intuitive that Lee's actual preparation is his first skill, "High Speed Taijutsu", while "Fifth Gate Opening" is meant to be a situational and defensive skill, preferably used when Lee already has at least 1 active stack of "High Speed Taijutsu".
Overall, we also expect Lee's gameplay to feel more fun this way.

cards.note: These changes aren't any kind of SUPER BOOST or anything like that. The skill is simply going back to how it originally was, with the difference being that it will now cost 1 Bloodline instead of 1 Taijutsu.This way, Dosu won't have to compete for a spot with other Taijutsu users anymore, and the game currently has very few characters that use 1 Bloodline + 1 Genjutsu, so I think it'll be interesting to make another option like that available directly from the first page.
